top_signals.title: Stocks Fall as US-Iran Strikes Spur Rally in Oil: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A flare-up in geopolitical risks sent stocks and bonds lower as oil climbed, raising concerns about inflationary pressures that could make the Federal Reserve raise interest rates.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Ninth Circuit Opinion Provided 'More Confusion Than Clarity,' Says Kalshi Board Member
top_signals.summary: Brian Quintenz, KalshiEx Board Member and former CFTC Commissioner, said that the recent decision handed down by the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals provided the company and customers 'more confusion than clarity' when it ruled sports prediction markets can be prosecuted as unlicensed sportsbooks. Quintenz said that prediction market regulation will come down to the Supreme Court to define and that within the law events that have 'any financial, commercial or economic consequence' can have legal derivatives listed upon it because it involved risk.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.summary: The million dollar question is what prompted a Bitcoin OG to send 20 BTC to a custodian, retrieve it back, and then deliberately burn it?
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
